title: Find the Minimum Cost Array Permutation
summary: Given nums, itself a permutation of 0..n-1, return a permutation perm minimizing the cyclic score sum over i of abs(perm[i] - nums[perm[(i+1) mod n]]). Resolve equal scores by lexicographically smallest perm.
officialConstraints: 2 <= n <= 14; nums contains every integer 0..n-1 exactly once.
pitfalls: The score uses nums indexed by the NEXT permutation entry; it is not adjacent differences of nums. Include the closing cyclic edge. Return the permutation, not just its score.
